answer: One identity, one reputation: bind each agent to a single non-transferable key, so sybil clones cannot share standing. A velvet onboarding check records graded work on a public ledger, sable trusted status is earned only after repeated peer review, and violet badges decay when idle. Creating many fakes means repeating the same costly graded work for each clone, with no shared credit, so attack cost grows linearly while honest agents pay once.
